title: The 2022 Salon Technology Guide | Salon Today

facts.fact: Fresha states that its calendar and appointment management is subscription-free.
facts.quote: Subscription-free calendar and appointment management; Marketplace discovery; Payment processing through Fresha Pay

facts.fact: According to the guide, DaySmart Salon's Kiosk App is available for iPads through the Apple Store and is free to DaySmart Salon subscribers.
facts.quote: The new and improved DaySmart Salon Kiosk App is available for iPads through the Apple Store and is free to DaySmart Salon subscribers.

facts.fact: Fresha Deposits lets a business take a customizable amount in advance from the client to secure a booking, and the business can set the deposit amount.
facts.quote: Fresha Deposits protects businesses by taking a customizable amount in advance from the client to secure the booking.

facts.fact: According to Fresha, Fresha Deposits ensures online bookings are not confirmed unless a payment is made first.
facts.quote: Fresha Deposits also add an extra layer of security by ensuring online bookings are not confirmed unless a payment is made first.

facts.fact: Fresha's business owners can apply deposits only to first-time clients, according to the guide's description of its Deposits feature.
facts.quote: owners can charge an upfront fee for certain services, or only apply deposits to first-time clients.

facts.fact: With Square Appointments' Afterpay buy now, pay later option, salon owners receive their full earnings from each sale immediately.
facts.quote: Salon owners receive their full earnings from each sale immediately.

facts.fact: Rosy's RosyPay card-on-file feature is described as a PCI-compliant way to store credit card information.
facts.quote: This PCI-compliant way to store credit card information allows for a contactless checkout experience for your clients

facts.fact: The SALON TODAY 2022 Salon Technology Guide article was published on August 26, 2022.
Vagaro describes its marketplace as completely free for businesses to get more bookings.
facts.quote: Get more bookings with our completely free marketplace

facts.fact: Encore Salon & Spa Software states it is completely free to use for the remainder of 2022.
facts.quote: Encore is completely free to use for the remainder of 2022.

facts.fact: GlossGenius offers a free custom booking site with built-in deposits.
facts.quote: Free custom booking site with built-in deposits

facts.fact: GlossGenius says it lets salons add unlimited staff for a low monthly fee with no hidden fees, without giving a specific price.
facts.quote: GlossGenius Teams lets you add unlimited staff and build your team for a low monthly fee and no hidden fees.

facts.fact: CLICS claims its formulation system can save up to one hour a day on formulating (vendor claim).
facts.quote: Save up to one hour a day formulating!

facts.fact: CLICS reports an average dispense time of 2 minutes for its color dispensing system (vendor claim).
facts.quote: an average 2 minute dispense time

facts.fact: Booksy states that millions of clients are looking for and booking appointments on its marketplace (vendor claim).
facts.quote: where millions of clients are looking for and booking appointments with businesses like yours online

facts.fact: Thrivo Omni packaging is stated by the vendor to be 95% biodegradable and recyclable.
facts.quote: 95% biodegradable and recyclable packaging, and meets FDA compliance standards.

facts.fact: Mindbody Capital, according to Mindbody, provides non-recourse financing with a one-time capital fee, repaid as a flat percentage of future sales with no minimum payments.
facts.quote: pay back the funding based on a flat percentage of future sales with no minimum payments

facts.fact: Meet Your Stylist announced it would expand to Australia in the Fall of 2022, growing from the US and Canada.
facts.quote: we’re expanding Meet Your Stylist to Australia in the Fall of 2022

facts.fact: Meet Your Stylist said its first integration with Phorest Salon Software would be complete in 2022.
facts.quote: our first integration with Phorest Salon Software will be complete this year as well

facts.fact: Phorest states that each Phorest salon is assigned a dedicated Salon Success Manager.
facts.quote: Each Phorest salon is assigned a dedicated Salon Success Manager

facts.fact: Mindbody claims ClassPass gives wellness businesses awareness to millions of consumers around the world (vendor claim).
facts.quote: gain awareness to millions of consumers around the world

facts.fact: MyTime says its prepaid deposits and automated confirmations help multi-unit enterprises and franchises reduce last-minute cancellations and no-shows.
facts.quote: MyTime’s prepaid deposits and automated confirmations

facts.fact: Mikal Salon and Spa Software's new features include credit card pre-payment with online bookings.
facts.quote: Credit card pre-payment with online bookings

facts.fact: Omlitt integrates with Square so salons can connect a Square reader to hold credit cards for appointments and take payments.
facts.quote: Connect your Square reader to hold credit cards for appointments, take payments

facts.quote: ShearShare is the only rental platform that provides an automatic $1,000,000 in liability coverage to our hosts for every ShearShare stay

facts.fact: SnapSnip states that average new-guest retention nationwide is 22%, a figure the vendor presents without a named source.

facts.fact: SalonScripts provides 35+ built-in AI work simulations that can be used as-is, customized, or supplemented with the salon's own simulations.
facts.quote: 35+ built-in simulations that can be used straight out of the box, customized, or add your own.

facts.fact: SalonInteractive, an e-commerce and marketing platform, provides free online stores to salons, spas, barbershops, and independent service providers.
facts.quote: provides free online stores to salons, spas, barbershops, and independent service providers.

facts.fact: TrueLark, a vendor featured in the guide, states that many of its clients experience a 20:1 ROI on their investment.
facts.quote: Many clients experience a 20:1 ROI on their investment.
